title: Alguien que anda por ahí
subtitle: Dreams are tilting toward this shore.

items.text: The teleportation ritual drops them midair, leaving Loggerhead to tumble to the ground in a clatter of metal.
The auction has just begun. Impassioned words from behind the screen heat up the atmosphere, drawing every eye to the stage.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Get up and quit quivering.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Oh, right, right. We need to look like regular guests here.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: So we take a seat, cheer and clap with the others, raise a paddle to bid some small amount that nothing will ever sell for.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: That way, we won't catch too much attention. Just do enough to slip by! Reminds me of a movie from 1928.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Shut it. Just shut it. I swear if you bring up another movie plot, I will sock you.
She only intended to get the camera-headed girl's nerves in check, but her sharp words catch the attention of a guest nearby.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Pardon me, ladies, but have you never attended an auction before?

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Um, no. I mean, we kinda know what's going on, but ...

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Don't you worry yourself over us, miss.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Oh, don't get me wrong. I mean no offense. Actually, this is my first time too.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Not so brushed up on the rules myself, let alone the argots.
The woman turns to them with a gentle smile. She fidgets with her handkerchief, looking a little lost.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Then what brings a lady like you here?

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: You were invited like everyone else, right? You must know you're on gang turf.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Yes, miss, that I do know. However, I have my reasons for coming.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Camila, my daughter, suffers from a rare disease. Her body rejects its own arcane power.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Her blood is escaping her body. There's nothing we can do to stop it.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: I have visited every arcane doctor in the city, and not one of them has a clue. They take it as a horrible and unbreakable curse. My dear Camila, there's not much time left for her.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Oh, I'm so sorry, ma'am.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: It's alright, truly. On one of my desperate visits to priests and witches while I was searching after a rumor about a miracle cure, I happened upon some smugglers.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: They told me I'd find what I was looking for at the Turquoise Serpent Club.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: And now, it seems spending just a few pesos on some art could win me a chance to strike a deal with the biggest smuggler in the city. As long as I find a phoenix feather, there is still hope for my dear child.
The woman finds herself getting increasingly worked up. Realizing she's on the verge of tears, she stops herself.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Oh, where are my manners? I'm talking your ears off.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: You seem quite unlike the other guests here.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: We've all come here with a purpose. Some of us are desperate to achieve those goals by any means necessary. Please be careful.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Same to you, ma'am. Hope your daughter gets better soon.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Thank you very much. Hm? Is it raining outside, or did a leak just spring? It suddenly smells damp.
In the dim room, she clutches her handkerchief tight as her breathing grows heavy.

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: *gasp* What's happening to me?

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: She-She can't breathe!
The camera-headed girl reaches out to steady the woman, but Ramona seizes her arm.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Don't touch her! Something's off here.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: The arcane power squeezing her is too strong! It'll suck you in if you get too close!

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: I see a lake ... water ... and something below ... It's strange and so very deep ...

items.speaker: Gentle Guest
items.text: Ah ... Oh ... Camila ...
Her gentle features twist in agony as she chokes for air. Rough gasps escape her throat like a broken bellows.
Then, all at once, she stops breathing.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: No, no, no! Don't! Ma'am! What on earth is going on?!
She collapses to the floor, drawing the attention of those nearby. The crowd draws a wide, panicked circle around her.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: Oh! What's happening over there?

items.speaker: Smuggler IV
items.text: Someone's fallen! My God. She's ... She's not breathing!

items.speaker: Smuggler IV
items.text: Murder! Murder!!
Panic spreads through the room.
Soon enough, every eye in the room turns toward the exorcist and the camera-headed girl.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Drowned without a drop of water, just like all the others.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: The murderer must be someone in the auction house.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: The question is, who?
You filthy murderer!
Dirty thug!
Intruder! Bandit! Robber!
Backstage Corridor

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: This room's a bit small for all five, wouldn't you say?
The unbothered murderer, thug, intruder, bandit, and robber raises an eyebrow.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Are you finished with your whining? It's time for you to choose your interrogation method.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Good news: You're in safe hands. I'm quite skilled at peeling people while keeping them alive.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Bad news: I've never tried these techniques on a mouse!

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: How about something more sleek, modern. Electrocution, perhaps?
She mutters to herself as she rummages through her case.
Before her, the mice huddle together in a trembling ball. At last, the largest of them squeaks out.

items.speaker: Mamá Pérez
items.text: S-Stop! What kind of interrogation is this?!

items.speaker: Mamá Pérez
items.text: You haven't even asked a question! This is pure torture!

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Given your connection to the murders in the city, I think the means justify the ends.

items.speaker: Mamá Pérez
items.text: You think I know which ones you're talking about? The club makes trouble "disappear" every week!

items.speaker: Mamá Pérez
items.text: But that's just how things go in this business!

items.speaker: Mamá Pérez
items.text: So please, Ms. Giant, please calm down! I'll tell you whatever you want. Just ask me!

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Alright, then I have some questions.
She reluctantly puts away her tools, eyeing the mice with a half-smile.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: How did you become "Mr. Pérez," and what is the connection between the club and Manus Vindictae, and—

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Where do you ship your special mineral pigment?

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: I need the type you smuggle for the Manus. Give me all you have. Every ounce.

items.speaker: Mamá Pérez
items.text: That pigment? You're after it too.
The eager mouse representative is cut off.
Something seems to have gone wrong in the audience. Screams and frantic footsteps follow.

items.speaker: Patroller V
items.text: Mr. Pérez! Mr. Pérez!

items.speaker: Patroller V
items.text: A guest has just died in the auction house! Can't believe someone had the guts to off her on our turf!

items.speaker: Patroller V
items.text: Wasn't any ordinary death, either. Folks are saying it's another of those serial killings!

items.speaker: Patroller V
items.text: The whole place is in chaos. We've got guests asking us to open the teleportation ritual so they can leave. Ms. Luisa wants to know your orders.

items.speaker: Patroller V
items.text: Wait, what are you two doing lying around here? You're supposed to be on duty!
In the backstage hallway, the unconscious patrollers are discovered.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: A sixth case, then.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: This should be interesting.
